name: HazeRD
description: A dataset and evaluation benchmark for single-image dehazing on outdoor scenes.
reputation: Moderately cited in the dehazing literature as an outdoor-scene benchmark, but less dominant than larger suites like RESIDE.
notes: Relatively small / domain-specific outdoor test sets; many methods report PSNR/SSIM which can miss perceptual quality; potential gap between synthetic and real hazy images; non-LLM benchmark.
